column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (tag:path, a release asset, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the bytes.
# v1.5.0 is the newest published release; there is no dev pre-release. Its reader is
# the pin v1.5.0 recorded, cameraunlock-core 34656598. The oracle compiles both files byte for
# byte. They also use MathUtils.Clamp01 and OpenTrackReceiver.DefaultPort, taken from the current
# core: Clamp01's body and DefaultPort = 4242 are the same at 34656598.
# The frozen reader in src/GoneHomeHeadTracking/Legacy is v1.5.0's LoadFromFile restructured to
# fill LegacyConfig and write nothing, over a copy of those ConfigParsingUtils methods, so
# comparison 1 is not empty by construction and runs on every input.
# No published build shipped HeadTracking.cfg, in a ZIP or as a launcher-manifest.json seed, so the
# inputs are what each build writes at its first start. A first-run file is the HeadTracking.cfg
# that build's own HeadTracking.dll, taken from its release ZIP, writes when
# HeadTrackingConfig.LoadFromFile runs on a path with no file: the published binary, with the
# CameraUnlock.Core.dll from the same ZIP and the Unity stubs of pixi run setup, run once under
# Windows PowerShell 5.1 (.NET Framework 4.8). v1.1.0 and v1.4.1 were tagged and never released.
